# Meadowlark Bistro Daily Shift Temperature Log and Corrective Action Report
Kitchen Station 2 - Morning Prep Shift
Date: 04/14/2026
Lead Prep: Caleb Nguyen | Shift Supervisor: Megan Hendricks

## Equipment Temperature Checks

| Unit ID | Equipment Type | Standard Range | Check 1 (07:00 AM) | Check 2 (11:00 AM) | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| REF-02 | Walk-in Cooler A | 33°F - 40°F | 37°F | 38°F | Normal |
| REF-05 | Low-Boy Prep Table | 33°F - 40°F | 46°F | 39°F | Action Req. |
| FRZ-01 | Main Reach-in Freezer | -10°F - 0°F | -2°F | -1°F | Normal |

## Time-Temperature Control for Safety (TCS) Food Verification

| Item Code | Food Description | Standard Limit | Measured Temp | Time Monitored | Initial |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PREP-101 | Diced Raw Chicken Breast | 41°F or below | 39°F | 10:30 AM | CN |
| PREP-104 | House Ranch Dressing | 41°F or below | 40°F | 10:45 AM | CN |
| SOUP-02 | Clam Chowder (Hot Hold) | 135°F or above | 148°F | 11:15 AM | BD |

## Corrective Action Log
- Incident 1: At 07:00 AM, Brandon Duarte identified unit REF-05 holding at 46°F, which violates cold-holding limits.
- Brandon Duarte adjusted the condenser dial and relocated prep inserts to Walk-in Cooler A.
- Technician service request submitted to facility maintenance for unit REF-05 gasket inspection.

## Prep Supervisor Sign-Off
- Shift temperatures reviewed with cook Brandon Duarte prior to meal rush.
- All hot and cold storage units operated within required limits throughout the shift.

errors.quote: relocated prep inserts to Walk-in Cooler A.
errors.explanation: Standard food safety procedure for an out-of-temperature unit requires recording the internal food temperatures of the relocated TCS food to confirm it did not enter the temperature danger zone prior to transfer.
errors.fix: checked internal food temperatures to confirm safe holding levels and relocated prep inserts to Walk-in Cooler A.

errors.quote: All hot and cold storage units operated within required limits throughout the shift.
errors.explanation: This statement is false because the table shows Low-Boy Prep Table REF-05 measured 46°F at 07:00 AM, exceeding the allowable cold-holding standard of 40°F and requiring corrective action.
errors.fix: Low-Boy Prep Table REF-05 exceeded standard limits at 07:00 AM but returned to normal range after corrective action.
